text.description_html:
Acorn RL1BP, 2-13/16 Arrowhead Latch

This early american black iron Arrowhead cabinet latch from Acorn Iron Hardware is designed for flush door installation (where the door is flush with its frame). The 2-13/16 Arrowhead Latch is packaged as a set: latch with plate, strike plate, and mounting screws. The Acorn made Arrowhead Latch is perfect for securing any lightweight door, be it a cabinet, armoire, or window shutter. The rough iron finish duplicates that found on the ironwork of many old European castles and cathedrals and imitates the natural weathering of iron.

Also Available 3-7/16" Arrowhead Latch

Specifications for the Acorn Arrowhead Cabinet Latch:

  • Finish: Rough Black Iron
  • Length: 2-13/16"
  • Width: 1-13/16"
  • Set Includes: latch, latch plate, strike plate, and mounting screws.

Sold Individually
